segments.sn13.4:1.2: “seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yatthimā mahānadiyo saṃsandanti samenti, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.sn13.4:1.3: gaṅgā yamunā aciravatī sarabhū mahī, taṃ udakaṃ parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya ṭhapetvā dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni.
segments.sn13.4:1.5: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yaṃ vā sambhejjaudakaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ yāni vā dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhānī”ti?
segments.sn13.4:2.1: “Etadeva, bhante, bahutaraṃ sambhejjaudakaṃ yadidaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ;
segments.sn13.4:2.2: appamattakāni dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhāni.
segments.sn13.4:2.3: Neva satimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na sahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti na satasahassimaṃ kalaṃ upenti sambhejjaudakaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādiṇṇaṃ upanidhāya dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhānī”ti.

lines: Pāḷiyaṃ vibhattilopena niddesoti tamatthaṃ dassento “tīṇi vā”ti āha.
Sambhijjati missībhāvaṃ gacchati etthāti sambhejjaṃ, missitaṭṭhānaṃ.
